title: Corporate Flight Bookings
summary: Given an array of flight bookings where each booking specifies a range of flights and the number of seats reserved, return an array indicating the total number of seats reserved for each flight.
statement: Given an array of flight bookings where each booking specifies a range of flights and the number of seats reserved, return an array indicating the total number of seats reserved for each flight.
constraints: Flights are labeled 1..n and booking endpoints are inclusive.
Return reserved seats for every flight in label order.
hints: Inclusive range additions can be represented by two difference-array events.
Add seats at first-1 and subtract at last when that index exists.
Prefix-sum the difference array to recover each flight total.
Each booking contributes from its start event until exactly its end-cancel event.
editorial: Each booking contributes from its start event until exactly its end-cancel event.

tests.explanation: Range additions total 10,55,45,25,25 across flights one through five.
The second flight receives both bookings for 25 seats.
